fusions.name: Running Out the Line
fusions.desc: A thrown strand that deals 5 damage. Its damage rises +5% per tile you have travelled (max +40%).

fusions.name: Ride Down
fusions.desc: You gallop to the target along a line and strike it for 18 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Full Gallop
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Tempo
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 15%.
